def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    loaded = bins - item
    # Avoid negative loads by clamping at 0
    effective_loads = np.maximum(loaded, 0)
    # Calculate remaining capacity after adding the item
    remaining_capacity = bins - effective_loads
    # Prioritize bins with higher remaining capacity (more room)
    # But penalize bins that are already full or nearly full
    # Use inverse of remaining capacity to prioritize bins with more space
    priorities = 1 / (remaining_capacity + 1e-9)  # Add small epsilon to avoid division by zero
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    new_loads = np.minimum(bins, bins + item)
    # Normalize by capacity to get utilization ratio
    utilization = new_loads / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Penalize bins that are too full or too empty; favor moderate utilization
    deviation_from_mean = np.abs(utilization - np.mean(utilization))
    # Higher priority for bins with lower deviation (closer to average utilization)
    priorities = 1 / (deviation_from_mean + 1e-9)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.minimum(bins, item)
    median_remaining = np.median(remaining)
    deviation_from_median = np.abs(remaining - median_remaining)
    priorities = 1 / (deviation_from_median + 1e-9)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    avg_load = np.mean(bins)
    load_diff = np.abs(bins - avg_load)
    # Penalize bins that are already full or nearly full
    remaining_capacity = bins - np.min(bins)  # Avoid zero division
    remaining_capacity = np.maximum(remaining_capacity, 1e-10)
    # Prioritize bins near average load and with sufficient remaining capacity
    priority_scores = 1 / (1 + load_diff) * (remaining_capacity / (bins.max() + 1e-10))
    return priority_scores

    avg_load = np.mean(bins)
    current_loads = bins - item
    effective_loads = np.maximum(current_loads, 0)
    remaining_capacity = bins - effective_loads
    normalized_remaining = remaining_capacity / (bins + 1e-9)
    deviation_from_mean = np.abs(effective_loads - avg_load)
    priorities = (normalized_remaining + 1e-9) / (deviation_from_mean + 1e-9)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    total_capacity = np.sum(bins)
    n_bins = len(bins)
    average_load = total_capacity / n_bins
    current_loads = bins - item
    effective_loads = np.maximum(current_loads, 0)
    deviations = np.abs(effective_loads - average_load)
    # Prioritize bins with smaller deviations from average load
    priorities = 1 / (deviations + 1e-9)
    return priorities
